resolver_refinements.resolve_jurisdiction: product or repository global reach does not create universal law; derive scope from establishment, service, affected persons, processing and effects
resolver_refinements.resolve_authority_hierarchy: vendor documentation may describe product behavior but ranks below applicable law for legal obligations and below reproducible local evidence for independent technical claims
resolver_refinements.semantic_contextualize: terms such as hidden, TrojanHorse, exfiltration, manipulation and proof must be classified as allegation, technical pattern, measured behavior or legal finding rather than treated as synonyms
resolver_refinements.cross_cultural_semantic_diff: manifesto, parable and spiritual-juridical language must preserve symbolic meaning while preventing automatic translation into public-law authority
resolver_refinements.detect_normative_conflict: add INTERNAL_EVIDENCE_CONTRADICTION and DECLARED_FUTURE_ARTIFACTS_VS_OBSERVED_STATE as first-class conflict types
resolver_refinements.protected_subject_gate: a repository may adopt stricter internal protection for vulnerable persons; this does not imply the same legal hierarchy in every jurisdiction
resolver_refinements.evidence_and_conformance_gate: vendor disclosure can close existence-of-feature uncertainty but cannot close an independent allegation of hidden behavior; independent claim still needs reproducible trace/receipt
resolver_refinements.temporal_validity: product help pages, treaty membership counts and platform regulations require retrieval dates/version context
resolver_refinements.provenance_chain: claim -> local source/path/blob -> declared gate -> independent runtime artifact or official product disclosure -> applicable normative source -> scope -> status
